title: Implementation team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/implementation.yaml: the team layer of the implementation plugin's settings. Resolution, layer order and the per-key exceptions: plugins/implementation/reference/config.md. Contract: docs/adr/0054-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

verify_mechanical_phases.description: When true, /implementation:implement and /implementation:implement-dispatch send every phase, mechanical ones included, to a fresh-context verifier. A floor: true in this file or in the user's verify_mechanical_phases option wins, so neither layer can switch off the other's true.
